survey_summary_paraphrase: A prediction can be traced through successive decision rules.
companion_note: Compact trees can be inspectable; very large trees may be difficult to follow.

survey_summary_paraphrase: If-then rules describe the decision logic.
companion_note: Inspect rule complexity, coverage and conflicts rather than assuming all rule sets are easy to understand.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Weights indicate the relative emphasis placed on input components.
companion_note: Attention weights alone do not establish a faithful or causal explanation.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Gradient-based activation maps highlight image regions associated with a prediction.
companion_note: Heatmaps show attribution under a chosen method, not proof of clinically correct reasoning.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Directed graphical models describe probabilistic dependencies.
companion_note: A dependency graph is not automatically a causal graph.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Feature attributions describe contributions relative to a chosen reference/background.
companion_note: The family includes model-specific implementations; background data and feature dependence affect interpretation.

survey_summary_paraphrase: An interpretable local surrogate approximates predictions near an instance.
companion_note: Locality, perturbations and random sampling affect fidelity and stability.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Average model response is displayed as a feature varies.
companion_note: Correlated predictors can make evaluated feature combinations unrepresentative.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Instance-level response curves expose heterogeneous model behaviour.
companion_note: These are conditional model probes, not measured effects of changing patient characteristics.

survey_summary_paraphrase: An interpretable model approximates a more complex predictor.
companion_note: Report agreement with the original predictor separately from accuracy against true outcomes.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Changes that would alter a prediction are sought.
companion_note: Feasibility and causal actionability require additional assumptions and checks.

survey_summary_paraphrase: Performance changes when a feature is permuted indicate model reliance.
companion_note: Dependence among features affects the result; importance is not causality.
